_comment: Early dangerous legs of the Act 1 quest routes (user request 2026-11-25, Questy bed: a clvl 4 Paladin walked Stony Field -> Underground Passage level 1 -> Dark Wood with no potions and died to Vile Hunters). A route closes to a hero under minLevel (by class family) or short of the kit. Areas: 10 Underground Passage level 1, 5 Dark Wood (its only way in). Numbers: SME ballpark, U (monster levels there are 6 to 7 in Normal). minLife is max life by class family (a clvl 8 Paladin with 69 life died twice to Treehead WoodFist's pack, Questy 2026-11-25; SME: under 110 is not fit, U). questWalk: every quest walk into a field from fromLevel up to belowLevel needs this kit (Questy bed 2026-11-26: a clvl 12 Paladin walked Stony Field with 0 potions and died); without gold for it the hero farms first. Owner try anyway overrides.
